spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Callum Pemberton. There’s a card payment I don’t recognise, and honestly I’m fed up with the bank. It’s £186.40 to Northstar Media.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into it. Before we discuss the account, please confirm your full name and date of birth.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I can see the payment from 19 October. I’m logging this as a complaint as well as a disputed card payment. The complaint reference is TB-641927.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good. I’ve tried to sort it online, but I don’t really understand online banking. My son normally does it for me, and he’s away.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. The Financial Support team can help you with online banking, or we can allow extra time while you do things by phone. I’ll note that.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I just want to know if I’ll get the money back.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise an outcome. We’ll investigate the payment and tell you what we find. And any bank fees can never be refunded.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s not very reassuring. I’ve already spent ages trying to get an answer.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll take ownership of this: I’ll send the disputed payment details to our card investigations team today and call you by 3 November with an update.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’ll receive a full written response to the complaint within 15 business days. I’ll make sure it’s sent to your address.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’re investigating the payment, you’ll call me by the third of November, and I’ll get the written complaint response within 15 business days?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ve noted your support needs too. Does that make sense?
